scope_guards: No Planning Data entity was invented where no current structured record was found.
The 164-unit 2018 proposal and the up-to-196-unit application are chronology, not additive capacity.
Thirty-five percent affordable housing is a tenure share, not additional homes.
The 2021 Cabinet record confirms consent on 5 February 2021 but not current implementation or completion.
The 2025 development-agreement termination and withdrawal of the up-to-GBP52m loan are finance and delivery events, not automatic planning-permission revocation.
A potential current or amended scheme is not treated as a new permission or capacity.
Local Plan allocation and Council land interests are not exact HMLR title topology.
No score or promotion is written without current permission finality, exact geometry, title relation and overlays.
